identificationModule.briefTitle: Assess Efficacy & Safety of Selumetinib in Combination With Docetaxel in Patients Receiving 2nd Line Treatment for v-Ki-ras2 Kirsten Rat Sarcoma Viral Oncogene Homolog (KRAS) Positive NSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Double-Blind, Randomised, Placebo-Controlled Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of Selumetinib (AZD6244; ARRY-142886) (Hyd-Sulfate) in Combination With Docetaxel, in Patients Receiving Second Line Treatment for KRAS Mutation-Positive Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non Small Cell Lung Cancer (Stage IIIB - IV) (SELECT 1)

armGroups.label: Selumetinib + Docetaxel
armGroups.description: Three 25mg Selumetinib capsules will be administered orally uninterrupted twice daily in combination with docetaxel 75 mg/m2 intravenously administered on day 1 of each 21 day cycle

armGroups.label: Placebo + Docetaxel
armGroups.description: Three placebo capsules will be administered orally uninterrupted twice daily in combination with docetaxel 75 mg/m2 intravenously administered on day 1 of each 21 day cycle.

interventions.name: Selumetinib
interventions.description: Three 25 mg selumetinib capsules (Hyd-Sulfate) be administered orally, twice daily, (total dose 75 mg dose bd) on an uninterrupted schedule.

interventions.name: Docetaxel
interventions.description: Docetaxel 75 mg/m2 will be administered intravenously on day 1 of each 21 day cycle.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Three placebo capsules will be administered orally uninterrupted twice daily in combination with docetaxel 75 mg/m2 intravenously administered on day 1 of each 21 day cycle.

interventions.name: Pegylated G-CSF
interventions.description: All patients will receive pegylated Granulocyte Colony Stimulating Factor (G-CSF) at least 24 hours after administration of every docetaxel dose and not within 14 days prior to the next docetaxel administration.
